podcast.body: This song was a hit and marked Jars of Clay as a significant breakout band from the alternative CCM movement. Their success helped pave the way for other bands, like DC Talk, to achieve modest mainstream recognition. "A hit from Jarz of Clay from 1996 called Flood."
